description:
Big adventures start with small wheels.
The Romper is a lightweight titanium balance bike made for toddlers taking their first steps into life on two wheels.
Built around a titanium frame and carbon fork, it weighs just 2.7kg, making it easy for little riders to control, pick up and manoeuvre as they develop their balance, coordination and confidence.
Titanium is an ideal material for a balance bike. It is exceptionally light, naturally corrosion resistant and tough enough to handle years of bumps, drops, muddy rides and outdoor adventures. Unlike a bike that might be outgrown and forgotten, the Romper is made to be passed between siblings, cousins and friends—and eventually handed down to the next generation.
Its 12-inch wheels provide a stable and manageable platform for toddlers, while the durable construction supports riders up to 40kg.
The carbon fork helps keep the weight low and gives the Romper the unmistakable look and feel of a proper Wondercross bike.

The Romper is more than a child’s first bike. It is the beginning of muddy shoes, scraped knees, big smiles and a lifetime of adventure on two wheels.
